'''Prey''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the Mod.  

When players get this effect, a new [[Scent System|Scent]] is created which will stay location of the Player at all times while the Debuff is active, teleporting to the Player after reaching a certain distance.

Prey cannot be removed by drinking Milk.
